Features — Dark Mode

  • Instant Transformation: Converts any website to dark mode with optimized color contrast.
  • Toggle On/Off: Easily switch between dark mode and the original site design.
  • Eye Comfort: Reduces blue light and glare for comfortable browsing, especially at night.
  • Battery Saving: Dark mode can extend battery life on OLED and AMOLED screens.

Use Cases - Comfortable Browsing

🌙 Night Browsing

Browse comfortably in low-light environments without straining your eyes. Perfect for late-night reading or research.

💻 Extended Work Sessions

Reduce eye fatigue during long work sessions. Dark mode is easier on the eyes for extended periods.

🔋 Battery Optimization

Save battery life on laptops and mobile devices with OLED screens. Dark pixels consume less power.

3-Second Install, Use Forever

1

Press and Hold Button

Click and hold the dark gray 'Dark Mode' button.

2

Drag to Bookmarks Bar

Dark Mode

Crucial Step: Drag the button to your browser's 'Bookmarks Bar' or 'Favorites Bar', then release the mouse.

3

Done! Click to Toggle

On any page, click this bookmark to toggle dark mode on or off.
